segments: The fastest and most forgiving upgrade path. Excellent for the main quest and crowd control.
Weather vane at the Bastion / Death Ray
Shoot the weather vane near the Death Ray with the base bow. Pick up the broken arrow that drops.
Use fully charged arrows to light the bonfires overlooking the village/spawn, outside the Clock Tower, and on the mountain near the Rocket Test area.
Activate low gravity in the Undercroft and wall-run across all five glowing wind symbols without touching the floor.
Feed zombie souls into the urns under the Clock Tower stairs, in the room above Double Tap near the workbench, and in the Rocket tunnel.
Draw a charged shot beside each filled urn to electrify the arrow, then use that charged arrow on one bonfire. Each urn powers one shot.
Return to the weather vane / electrical cloud and interact to receive the reforged Storm arrow.
Place the arrow into the blue Storm altar around the Pyramid, feed it zombie souls, then insert the Wrath of the Ancients and collect the upgraded Storm Bow.
Do the low-gravity wall run before the room gets crowded.
A missed bonfire shot normally means recharging from the matching urn.
